slots.event: يُوسُف lives in a big house with his mother, father, little sister لَيْلَى and a big cat; the cat lives beside the door

slots.must_not_show: the ball, the book, the pen, the key — nobody holds anything
slots.risks: four people + cat in one frame: keep everyone small and separated; the cat must read as big (about a child's waist height)

slots.event: Yusuf wants the ball and does not have it
slots.show: Yusuf (-q) alone, both hands open and empty
slots.must_not_show: the ball anywhere; Layla
slots.risks: the empty hands are the whole meaning

slots.event: Layla has the ball and asks what he will give her — she wants his book; his book is with their mother

slots.must_not_show: the pen; the father; the ball

slots.event: At the door: the father, ready to go out, has the pen and needs his key; Yusuf sums up everyone's wants and the father laughs

slots.risks: the key must be legible at strip size under the cat: show bow + teeth

slots.event: The chain runs back: key to father, pen to mother, book to Layla, ball to Yusuf — he laughs

slots.must_not_show: the cat near the ball

slots.must_not_show: the cat running off with the ball (revision 3's ending)
